loading_tips: Mavis swings her handbag harder when Harold is in trouble. Get in trouble.
Dizzy thugs see stars. Tap ACT to finish them before the stars wear off.
Hold ACT near a downed partner to revive. Mavis does not take IOUs.
The minimap is a button. Tap it for the full harbor map.
Cane quake knocks down everything within five meters. Including pride.
Thugs sleep when you're far away. Sneak up like a toad in slippers.
Night lasts five minutes. So does Harold's patience.
Water taxis stop at the piers. Ride in style, pay in croaks.
Boss rings glow on the street. Step in and press ACT when you're ready.
Lost a boss fight? RETRY starts you from the phase you reached.
Drag the screen to look around. Harold's neck isn't what it used to be.
The radio is on M. Tap the dial to change stations.
Crime drops to zero when a district's boss goes down.
Seawalls stop you from falling in. Harold has fallen in before. Long story.
Swing, swing, ACT: cancel a cane combo into a cane quake.
Rowhouse stoops make great lookout posts. And great places to sit.
Every landmark has a story. Walk close to read it.
Federal Hill is the high ground. Use it. Harold's knees will forgive you.
Phone tip: the big green button is ACT. It does whatever makes sense.
When in doubt, follow the smell of crab cakes.
tutorial_tips: Use the stick or WASD to move Harold around the harbor.
Tap SWING or press J to swing your cane.
Press JUMP or K to hop over curbs and trouble.
ACT is your do-everything button: talk, ride, finish, fight.
Walk to a pier stop and press ACT to board a boat.
Press ACT again on a boat or vehicle to get off.
Tap the radio or press M to change the station.
Tap the minimap or press Tab to open the full map.
Stars over a thug mean dizzy. Press ACT to finish them.
Glowing rings mark boss fights. Step in, press ACT.
Mavis follows you. If she's down, hold ACT near her.
Drag the screen or use Q and R to turn the camera.

crime_meter.clear_message: The Inner Harbor is clear. Paddle boats are back out!
Cobble Point is safe. The pubs can sing again, hon.
Stoop Row is clear. Pull up a lawn chair and relax.
Market Ward is quiet. The coddies taste better already.
Monument Hill is clear. Even the column looks prouder.
The Yards are clean. The otters went home to dry off.

drone_captions: Fort McHenry's defense in 1814 inspired the poem that became the national anthem.
The USS Constellation, launched in 1854, is the US Navy's last all-sail warship.
The National Aquarium opened on the Inner Harbor's Pier 3 in 1981.
Harborplace opened in 1980 and helped turn the Inner Harbor into a tourist waterfront.
Lexington Market, founded in 1782, is one of the oldest public markets in America.
Fells Point was laid out in the 1760s and still has many of its cobblestone streets.
Baltimore's Washington Monument, begun in 1815, was the first big one to Washington.
Federal Hill is named for a 1788 party celebrating Maryland ratifying the Constitution.
Baltimore's World Trade Center is the world's tallest regular pentagonal building.
Edgar Allan Poe is buried at Westminster Burying Ground in downtown Baltimore.
The Power Plant on Pier 4 once made electricity for the city's streetcars.
The big neon sugar sign at Locust Point has lit up the harbor since 1951.
